voiceSummary: Gujarat Kidney and Super Speciality Limited filed a transcript of its earnings call for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue of INR80 crores for FY26, with H1 FY27 revenue at INR72.4 crores. EBITDA for H1 FY27 was INR18.6 crores, and PAT was INR11.9 crores. The firm operates 11 hospitals and 10 pharmacies across 9 cities. Management highlighted an asset-light, acquisition-led model. The company acquired a 51% stake in a polyclinic in Dubai with an existing revenue base of approximately INR20 crores. Net worth stood at INR263.6 crores as of September 30, 2026. Cash and bank balances were INR32.2 crores against borrowing of INR17.3 crores. The company plans to upgrade existing hospitals and pursue selective inorganic opportunities.
